title: Concerns over Tender and Eventual Award of Patrol Boat Contract to ST Marine
what_it_is: Concerns over Tender and Eventual Award of Patrol Boat Contract to ST Marine

sections.label: CPIB debarment recommendation after corruption conviction
sections.summary: CPIB can recommend debarment to the Standing Committee on Debarment after a Court decision establishing bribery linked to a Government agency or contract.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Specifically, with regard to corruption, CPIB can, where appropriate, recommend to the Ministry's Standing Committee on Debarment (SCOD) debarment action after a Court decision which establishes that the contractor or any of its employees, directors, partners or sole proprietor had bribed a public sector officer or another person in connection with a Government agency or contract.

sections.label: ST Marine no Government contract link
sections.summary: CPIB investigations into ST Marine revealed no connection with a Government agency or contract, so debarment circumstances did not arise.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: In the case involving ST Marine, CPIB investigations did not reveal any connection with a Government agency or contract.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: Hence, the circumstances in which debarment can be recommended under the policy parameters did not arise.

sections.label: Notice of award published within 72 days
sections.summary: The notice of award was published within 72 days from the tender award under the Government Procurement Regulations.

sentences.speaker: The Second Minister for Finance (Ms Indranee Rajah) (for the Minister for Finance)
sentences.text: The notice of award was published within 72 days from the tender award in accordance with the Government Procurement Regulations.

sections.label: Debarment protects Government interest
sections.summary: Debarment disqualifies suppliers that caused the Government harm or loss from getting fresh procurement and revenue contracts from all Government agencies.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: For that, debarment would apply, and I had explained that the main purpose of debarment is to protect the interest of the Government by disqualifying suppliers that have caused the Government to suffer harm or loss from getting fresh contracts, for both procurement and revenue contracts, from all Government agencies.

sections.label: Tender award committees consider track records
sections.summary: The response covered debarment policy parameters, but tender-awarding committees can holistically consider suppliers' track records, including corruption convictions.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: So, in other words, because the Parliamentary Question was filed with respect to debarment and, hence, my response was on the policy parameters that apply to debarment.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: But in terms of award of tender, the committees or whoever would be awarding the tender can look at it holistically and take into account the suppliers' track records which could include corruption convictions.

sections.label: Debarment rationale protects Government interest
sections.summary: The current policy rationale for debarment is protection of the Government interest against harm or loss.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: As I have explained, the current policy rationale for the debarment is protection of the Government interest against harm or loss.

sections.label: Tender assessment risk guard
sections.summary: The Member clarified the purpose is to guard against risk, which is addressed by taking the tender assessment holistically.

sentences.speaker: Ms Indranee Rajah
sentences.text: If the purpose is, as the Member has clarified, to guard against risk, that is addressed by taking into account the tender assessment holistically.
